static_traits.name: Wang Fulin
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk to, but not yet sharing this specific concern with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problem history; never received other psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Highly cooperative, clear expression, able to specifically describe Anxiety and sleep troubles; cautious tone, tending to avoid direct communication with the roommate; Positive attitude, willing to try counseling suggestions

basic_info.main_problem: I worry my roommate will find my snoring bothersome and decide to move out, which gives me Anxiety and stress.
basic_info.core_demands: 'The Fear of my roommate moving out because of my snoring is too strong, already affecting overall well-being, leading me to seek support and guidance in counseling.' Also, 'the ideal outcome is the roommate saying this is not a big problem, or giving feedback on how to better manage it together'.

core_beliefs: I will cause trouble to others because of my own problems, and relationships will be damaged or end as a result

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the roommate is dissatisfied with the noise, it means my snoring is the problem, and he will choose to move out
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not communicating directly with the roommate, trying to use earplugs and change sleeping positions to reduce the impact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He really is annoyed by my snoring and is considering moving out

special_situations.event: Repeatedly thinking about the snoring problem At night before sleep when Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot solve the snoring immediately, life and the cohabitation relationship will get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly worrying in bed, unable to fall asleep, work affected the next day
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things will develop to the worst possible point — he will move out, and I will fall into a worse situation

special_situations.event: Recalling the roommate's past noise complaints
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as a few noise complaints occur, it means my snoring is always the problem and will eventually cause him to leave
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being more careful, continuously Self-monitoring and avoiding starting conversations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Such complaints are always followed by leaving

special_situations.event: Not yet communicating with the roommate, lacking clear feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not heard clear reassurance or a solution, it means he is dissatisfied and will leave soon
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presuming the worst outcome and mentally preparing, but continuing to avoid the conversation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must be dissatisfied and will move out soon

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be accepted and to live stably and harmoniously with roommates
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected or abandoned (roommate moving out)
defense_goal: Avoiding conflict and direct conversation to maintain superficial stability and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A cohabitant who worries about Being rejected and easily blames oneself
object_relations.object_representation: A roommate who is easily disturbed and may leave at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to communicate directly with the roommate about the snoring problem, or thinking of the roommate's noise complaints before sleep
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client interprets the roommate's 'occasional complaints about noise' as dissatisfaction with their snoring, inferring the other will leave (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant, tactful tone; avoiding directly Questioning or seeking clear answers, instead describing one's own unease and apology, using indirect expression to lower confrontation.

manifestations: Worrying the roommate will move out because of one's snoring, leaving one Living alone
Repeatedly worrying At night before sleep, difficulty falling asleep

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to act toward others or the outside, turning the energy originally directed outward onto themselves instead.
manifestations: Not communicating directly with the roommate, instead changing sleeping positions and using earplugs
Uses energy on self-adjustment rather than relationship negotiation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Believes the roommate is annoyed by their snoring and is considering moving out, lacking direct evidence to support it

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and accept behavioral experiment suggestions
Positive attitude, willing to try planning a conversation with the roommate
Having some self-regulation attempts (using earplugs, adjusting sleeping positions)
Having some Social support (having friends to talk to, though not yet sharing the specific concern)
negative_force: Catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, and mind-reading tendencies
Avoiding direct communication, excessive Self-monitoring and self-blame
Sleep impairment leading to decreased daytime functioning
Overly caring about others' views, seeking others' clear affirmation to relieve unease (external validation tendency)

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry before sleep that the roommate will move out because of one's snoring, causing significant Anxiety and insomnia
antecedent: Thinking about the roommate's occasional complaints about noise
target_behavior.core_reason: Worry about Being rejected/abandoned, plus cognitive biases of catastrophizing, mind-reading, and fortune-telling
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome situations (conflict and uncertainty), trying to gain a sense of control through worry
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty falling asleep, poor sleep quality, worsening Anxiety, Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids directly communicating the snoring issue with the roommate
antecedent: Thinking of possible embarrassment or the other's dissatisfaction
Tension and fear arising when preparing to start a conversation
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being negated or the relationship breaking, tending toward personalization and jumping to conclusions
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection or conflict to maintain surface stability
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent uncertainty and Anxiety, the problem not yet Clarified or negotiated, damaged sleep and relationship quality
